name: Gare de Massy-Palaiseau
about: Massy-Palaiseau's station rebuilt (godot/lots/rerB/tool/massy_station.py, with the RER B by godot/lots/rerB/tool/build_rail.py): its footbridges and halls, the line 18 box, the bus station and the bus depot (godot/lots/rerB/tool/bus_depot.py: its hangar, talus, bed and avenue's trees), the parked RER B trains; its plan lots/massyPalaiseau/plan.json, its own ground (lots/massyPalaiseau/ground.*: the bus station's islands, the line 18 shaft, the ground mended where the LiDAR saw a building site) and its changes to the map's world (lots/massyPalaiseau/drop.json), built by lots/massyPalaiseau/massy_builder.gd and hangar_builder.gd.
